summary: Iteration 23: CP67 Mall Dark Theme UI Overhaul - All pages verified with dark 'Kinetic Luxury' theme. Login flow works (phone 9876543210, OTP 1234). All inner pages have dark backgrounds (rgb(20, 11, 0)) with gold accents (#C9A55A). No white/cream backgrounds visible.
passed_tests: Login flow: Phone 9876543210, OTP 1234 - works correctly
Welcome page: Dark background (rgb(20, 11, 0)), gold gift icon, Sign In button
Login page: Dark background, gold Send OTP button, OTP inputs with dark styling
Home page: Dark background (rgb(20, 11, 0)), points card with gold accents, quick actions (Scan Bill, Redeem, Events, Explore), banner carousel, featured stores
Wallet page: Dark background (rgb(20, 11, 0)), wallet card, tier progress bar, breakdown stats, Scan Bill/Redeem buttons
Stores page: Dark background (rgb(20, 11, 0)), search bar, floor filter dropdown, 17 category pills, 101 store cards with dark styling
Profile page: Dark background (rgb(20, 11, 0)), gold avatar border, BRONZE MEMBER badge, personal info section with gold icons, 3 profile sections
Tier Journey page: Dark background, current tier card (Bronze), vertical reward ladder with 7 tiers, points earning slab (10 Points = INR 1)
Bill Upload page: Dark background (rgb(20, 11, 0)), capture zone with gold camera icon, Open Camera and Gallery buttons
Bottom navigation: Floating pill design with glassmorphism, 5 tabs (Home, Explore, Scan center, Wallet, Profile), all tabs functional
critical_code_review_comments: Dark theme CSS variables correctly applied: --cp-bg: #140B00, --cp-gold: #C9A55A
All page backgrounds use var(--cp-bg) which resolves to rgb(20, 11, 0)
Gold accents (#C9A55A) replace previous brown (#C68939) throughout
Glass panel effects use rgba(255,255,255,0.05) for subtle overlays on dark backgrounds
Border colors use rgba(255,255,255,0.1) for subtle dark theme borders
